lbl14A2Not0.name: Choose Mario pose: spin, slide, duck, walk
summary: Second half of the Mario pose selector (earlier part is in the chunk before). Picks the pose number for this frame and ends by
storing it in MarioFrame via $D01A.
Order: spin jump or cape spin, slope slide, ducking, fireball, kick, pick-up, face camera, then walking/standing based on
|X speed|. Falls into MarioAnimNoAbs1.

MarioAnimNoAbs1.name: Walk animation frame counter
summary: Takes A = |X speed|. If standing still, resets the walk frame (or sets 'looking up' pose offset 3 when Up is held).
Otherwise counts the walk frame [$13DB] down whenever the animation timer [$1496] has run out and reloads the timer from
DATA_00DC7C (shorter timer at higher speeds). Leaves the new frame in B for Remember.

Remember.name: Finish pose: add offsets, store frame
summary: Parameters: A = walk frame, X = |X speed|.
Stores the walk frame in [$13DB], adds the pose offset [$13DE] (+7 carrying an item, +4 when fast), then handles the 45 degree
slope poses. Entries at $D01A (A = final pose) and $D003 are jumped to from the code above.

MarioAnimNo45.name: Store Mario pose and return
summary: Writes A to MarioFrame and returns (RTL), ending the pose selector.

s00D034.name: Table: cape interaction offsets
summary: Two tables of four 16-bit offsets from Mario's position, indexed by 2 * A; used by CODE_00D044 for the cape hit point.

s00D044.name: Cape hit point, cape spin and fireball input
summary: $D044: sets the cape interaction point [$13E9]/[$13EB] from Mario's position plus a table offset.
$D062: called each frame; Cape Mario starts a spin ([$14A6] = $12) when Y is pressed (not ducking, on Yoshi or already spinning).
Fire Mario shoots a fireball when Y is pressed, or alternately left and right every 16 frames while spin jumping.

MarioDeathAni.name: Mario animation 9: death
summary: Sets the death pose and counts down the death timer [$1496] (every 4 frames). When it expires: exits the level with no event
([$0DD5] = $80), loses Yoshi, takes a life and chooses Game Over, Time Up or fade to overworld.

DeathNotGameOver.name: Death: choose fade to overworld or Time Up
summary: Y = game mode $0B (fade to overworld) unless the level timer ran out, in which case X = $1D (TIME UP message) is used.

DeathShowMessage.name: Death: start the message and set game mode
summary: Parameters: X = message number ($14 GAME OVER, $1D TIME UP), Y = game mode to switch to.
Sets the message number, animation and timer, then game mode $15 (fade to Game Over).

DeathNotTimeUp.name: Death: set game mode and return
summary: Game mode = Y.

DeathNotDone.name: Death: Mario falls, flips pose
summary: While the death timer is < $26 Mario's X speed is zeroed, Y speed is applied and the death pose flips left/right every 4 frames.

GrowingAniImgs.name: Table: Mario poses while changing size

PowerDownAni.name: Mario animation 1: power down
summary: Counts [$1496] down, showing poses from GrowingAniImgs. When it reaches 0, starts the invincibility flash ([$1497] = $7F) and
ends the animation.

MushroomAni.name: Mario animation 2: mushroom power up
summary: Plays the grow poses in reverse as [$1496] counts down; then power-up += 1 and the animation ends.

CapeAni.name: Mario animation 3: cape power up
summary: Hides Mario under the smoke puff. When the timer ends: small/big go to the flash code, cape/fire end the animation directly.

FlowerAni.name: Mario animation 4: flower power up
summary: Cancels cape flight and sliding, resets the pose, and counts down the flashing palette timer. Ends the animation when it is 0.

HIDEPIPESETS.name: Table: Mario hide values by pipe type

DoorPipeAni.name: Mario animation 5: horizontal pipe
summary: Ignores the controller, picks a walking pose, centers Mario on the pipe tile vertically, handles the face-camera timer and hides
Mario while he moves through the pipe. Shares its tail with VertPipeAni ($D22D). Helper at $D1F4 ticks [$14A2] and the animation timer.

VertPipeAni.name: Mario animation 6: vertical pipe
summary: Handles all pipe travel (vertical and horizontal). Centers Mario on Yoshi, sets pose, fakes X/Y held, puts Mario behind scenery,
sets his speed from [$89] & 3 while the timer [$88] counts down, hides him when it ends, and then either finishes (leaving a pipe)
or loads the next level (game mode $0F, entering a pipe). $D27C is unused.

PipeCannonAni.name: Mario animation 7: shot from pipe cannon
summary: Flies Mario out of a diagonal pipe at X speed $40, Y speed $C0 while the timer [$88] counts down. Plays a sound at $18 and then
puts Mario in front of the scenery, unlocks sprites; finishes like leaving a pipe.

s00D2BD.name: Table: jump Y speed by X speed

s00D2CD.name: Table: X decelerations, ground and air
summary: 16-bit decelerations indexed by slope state; used by the X speed code around $D78C.

s00D309.name: Table: X decelerations, water
summary: 16-bit decelerations used instead of DATA_00D2CD when in a water level.

MarioAccel?.name: Table: walk and run accelerations
summary: Mario acceleration tables (D345-D5E6). Each row is 8 bytes: four 16-bit words left walk, left run, right walk, right run; rows indexed by slope/state.
The listing rows are offset by one byte from the real row starts.

lines.00CF19: / Spin jump or cape spin active ([RAM_IsSpinJump] | [$14A6])?
lines.00CF1C: Neither: go to the normal pose selection at $CF4E
lines.00CF28: / On the ground: skip the Y adjustment
lines.00CF2C: / Moving up: skip the Y adjustment
lines.00CF2E: Falling: Y += 1 (second cape image of the pair)
lines.00CF3D: / Mario direction = DATA_00CEA1[X] (spin makes Mario face left/right in turn)
lines.00CF45: / Cape Mario: set the cape interaction point (CODE_00D044)
lines.00CF4B: / A = DATA_00CE99[X] (spin pose), go store it as Mario's pose ($D01A)
lines.00CF53: / [$13ED] = 0: go to $CF62; 1-$7F: use it as the pose ($CF85)
lines.00CF69: / A = $3C (probably ducking pose), or $1D if carrying an item ([$148F] != 0)
lines.00CF6D: / Ducking while jumping: use that pose ($CF85)
lines.00CF74: A = $3F: probably throwing-fireball pose on the ground
lines.00CF7C: / In the air: A = $16 instead, use it
lines.00CF83: / Kick timer = 0: go on to $CF88, else fall into the store
lines.00CF85: Use A as Mario's pose: go to $D01A
lines.00CF8D: / Pick-up timer non-zero: use that pose
lines.00CF94: / Face-camera timer non-zero: use that pose
lines.00CF9B: Non-zero: go to MarioAnimNoAbs1 (A = 0, acts as standing still)
lines.00CFA4: / [$14A0] non-zero: go to the walk animation code ($CFBC)
lines.00CFB1: / Not carrying anything: use A as the pose
lines.00CFB5: / Carrying an item in the air: pose $09
lines.00CFC2: / A = |Mario X speed| (also entered by JSL from DoorPipeAni)
lines.00CFC6: Stash A (= 0) in B: walk frame resets to 0
lines.00CFD2: / Up held: pose offset [$13DE] = 3 (looking up), go to $D002
lines.00CFE0: / [$13E5] = $68: animation speed class used in slippery levels
lines.00CFE9: / Animation timer [$1496] non-zero: keep the frame, go to $D003
lines.00CFF3: Stash the frame number in B
lines.00CFFC: A = DATA_00DC7C[Y]: frames to show the next walk frame (shorter when faster)
lines.00D002: A = new walk frame (swap B back into A)
lines.00D012: / Carrying an item: A += 7, go to $D01A
lines.00D01D: / Not on a 45 degree slope: go to MarioAnimNo45
lines.00D053: / Cape interaction X [$13E9] = Mario X + DATA_00D034[Y]
lines.00D05C: / Cape interaction Y [$13EB] = Mario Y + DATA_00D03C[Y]
lines.00D074: / Ducking, on Yoshi or spin jumping: return
lines.00D08E: / Y newly pressed: shoot a fireball ($D0AA)
lines.00D09D: / Spin jump: count frames in [$13E2], act only every 16th frame
lines.00D0A7: / Y = bit 4 of the counter (alternates every 16 frames)
lines.00D0A8: Mario direction = Y (fireballs alternate left and right)
lines.00D0CD: / [$0DD5] = $80: leave the level with no exit event
lines.00D0DF: / Music request $0A on $1DFB (probably Game Over music)
lines.00D0E6: Y = $0B: game mode = fade to overworld
lines.00D0F1: / Level time digits [$0F31]-[$0F33] non-zero: go to $D104
lines.00D102: Y = $15: game mode = fade to Game Over
lines.00D10A: / Death timer >= $26: return (Mario hangs in place first)
lines.00D11A: / Mario direction = bit 2 of frame counter (flips every 4 frames)
lines.00D11D: Pose numbers used while changing size, indexed by timer / 4
lines.00D145: Go end the animation and unlock sprites ($D158)
lines.00D16B: / Small or big Mario: go to $D140 (flash)
lines.00D16D: Cape or fire: go to $D158 (no flash)
lines.00D177: / [$13ED] bit 7 and [$1407] both clear: go to $D187
lines.00D18F: Pipe speed bytes: $00,$00 (X speed for up/down), $F0 (Y speed, up)
lines.00D193: Values for [$78] by pipe type, indexed [$89] / 2 + 1
lines.00D1A1: Pick a walking pose from the X speed (enters at $CFBC)
lines.00D1DF: / Pipe timer [$88] >= $1D: go store A to [$78] ($D1F0)
lines.00D1F2: Go to the shared pipe code ($D22D)
lines.00D1FF: Mario X & $F targets for centering on a pipe: direction 0 = $0A, 1 = $06
lines.00D20E: / A = $0F (facing camera); not on Yoshi: use it ($D22A)
lines.00D21D: At or past the target: nudge left (X = 0)
lines.00D228: A = $21: pose going down a pipe on Yoshi
lines.00D23C: / C = [$89] >= 4 (leaving a pipe); Y = [$88]: timer 0: go to $D268
lines.00D245: / Still counting or leaving: go to $D24E
lines.00D24B: [$1405] += 1 (probably marks the pipe entry as done)
lines.00D256: / Mario not moving yet: play sound $04 on $1DF9 (pipe)
lines.00D268: Entering a pipe: go to $D273 to load the next level
lines.00D270: End the animation and unlock sprites ($D158)
lines.00D29A: Timer ran out: finish like leaving a pipe ($D26A)
lines.00D2A7: / Play sound effect $09 on $1DFC (probably the cannon blast)
lines.00D2BD: Initial jump Y speed, indexed by X speed (faster = higher jump)
lines.00D2CD: X deceleration (16-bit) used on ground/air, indexed by slope state
lines.00D309: X deceleration (16-bit) used in water levels
lines.00D345: Walk/run accelerations start here: 4 words per row (left walk, left run, right walk, right run)
lines.00D5BD: Maximum slope sliding speeds while carrying an item
lines.00D5C9: Auto-slide speeds per slope type (no buttons held)
lines.00D5E2: Rows from $D5E7: speed when no buttons are held in water
